profile.builtBy: The Philippines’ DOST and University of the Philippines, with Tohoku and Hokkaido Universities in Japan
profile.story: Diwata-2 is a Philippine Earth-observation microsatellite. Its amateur radio unit, PO-101, can run as an FM repeater or an APRS digipeater, and it is switched on for scheduled passes that the team announces in advance, so check the schedule before you count on it.
